headline: Miley Cyrus got married. It started with a blind date.
summary: Miley Cyrus, 33, married Maxx Morando, 28, a drummer with the band Liily, in Palm Springs, California, on November 21. They were set up on a blind date and have been together four years. He proposed on the last day of a trip to Japan, and she said she was 'so, so, so surprised.' Her parents were both there. So was a golden retriever.
cover_answer: A date someone else sets up. The two hadn't met.
table_question: Is it OK to keep a secret to make a surprise?

5-7.chip: Bring it up if it fits the day
5-7.script: A singer called Miley Cyrus got married on Saturday in California, in a white silk dress with white roses all around her, like a garden. Her mum and dad and her sister came, and so did a golden retriever, who got into the photos. Her new husband plays the drums in a band. Dogs are allowed at weddings, it turns out.
5-7.why: The dress, the roses and the dog are the whole story at six. Nothing here needs explaining, so don't.
5-7.why_long: A six-year-old takes one vivid feature for the whole event, so the script hands over a good one: a dog in the wedding photos. The dress, the roses and the drums are things a child can see, and none of it needs a parent's face read first. Expect 'can I come to a wedding?' Yes, when someone you know has one.

8-12.chip: Bring it up if it fits the day
8-12.script: Miley Cyrus says she is hard to surprise because she likes to control every situation. So Maxx Morando planned the proposal like a magic trick: he waited until the last day of their trip to Japan, so she would stop expecting it. It worked, and on Saturday they got married.
8-12.why: A planned surprise is a chain they can follow: she expects it, he waits her out, it lands.
8-12.why_long: A twelve-year-old is working out how a plan beats a guess, and this proposal is a plan: she expects it, so he waits until the expecting runs out. That is the timing a kid uses on a birthday surprise, and the script shows it from the planner's side. Expect 'did she know?' He thinks she sensed it coming, and he beat her anyway.

13-17.script: Is a good surprise a kind of lie? Maxx Morando says he 'had to be really sneaky' to propose to Miley Cyrus, who likes to control every situation. She loved it. Second: she married Liam Hemsworth in 2018 and separated in 2019. Is this one a bigger bet, or a better-informed one?
13-17.why: Sneaky and kind in one act is two true things. Let them judge the second marriage before you do.
13-17.why_long: A teenager can hold two true things at once, and the proposal is both: he hid it from her, and she loved it. The 2018 marriage that ended in 2019 is the second pair, a reason to be careful and a reason to know what you want. Kuhn's point is that making a case is practised, so let them. Expect 'how did you two meet?' Tell them.

5-7.q: Was the dog at the wedding?
5-7.a: It was in the photos, standing next to the two of them. The story doesn't say what else it did.

8-12.a: A date someone else sets up for two people who haven't met.

8-12.q: Why keep the proposal a secret?
8-12.a: She's hard to surprise. He waited until the trip's last day.

13-17.q: Is sneaky OK if it's for something nice?
13-17.a: He thought so. She called it a surrender and loved it. Where's the line?
Yes, Liam Hemsworth, 2018. They separated in 2019.
